selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
致盲你前方锥形区域的目标，使其迷惑地乱走，持续5秒。伤害会解除该效果。

当致盲冰雨结束时，敌人会减速50%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 自动攻击有一定几率产生3点符文能量。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 反魔法护罩的冷却时间缩短20秒，持续时间和吸收量提高40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自动攻击使目标的自动攻击速度降低5%，持续30秒，最多叠加4次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的吸收效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Absorbs are 15% more effective on you.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你受到爆击的几率降低3%，你的护甲提高6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 巫妖之躯的持续时间延长2秒，冷却时间缩短30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的疾病效果有几率削弱你的敌人，使你对其造成的伤害提高6%，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 制造一个反魔法领域，持续6秒，使小队或团队成员受到的魔法伤害降低15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的35%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 35% of the damage dealt.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
灵界打击的消耗减少10点，且治疗效果提高60%。

 鲜血
灵界打击的消耗减少5点，且治疗效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.

 Blood
Death Strike's cost is reduced by 5, and its healing is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
耐力提高12%。


 鲜血
耐力提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Stamina increased by 12%.


 Blood
Stamina increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 急速提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Haste by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
将黑暗的力量灌注到两把武器中，总计造成[([153.12% of Attack Power]) + ([29.835% of Attack Power])]点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的(20 / 饮血: 21 / 强化灵界打击: 32)%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。

 鲜血,  邪恶
将黑暗的力量灌注到武器中，造成([153.12% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的(20 / 饮血: 21 / 强化灵界打击: 32)%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blood,  Unholy
Focuses dark power into a strike that deals (153.12% of Attack Power) Physical damage and heals you for (20 / Voracious: 21 / Improved Death Strike: 32)% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.

 Frost
Focuses dark power into a strike with both weapons, that deals a total of [(153.12% of Attack Power) + (29.835% of Attack Power)] Physical damage and heals you for (20 / Voracious: 21 / Improved Death Strike: 32)% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤一个 [恶鬼雕文: 恶鬼 / 食尸鬼]为你作战。你一次最多只能召唤一个 [恶鬼雕文: 恶鬼 / 食尸鬼]。持续1分钟。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Raises a [Glyph of the Geist: geist / ghoul] to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one [Glyph of the Geist: geist / ghoul] at a time. Lasts 1 min.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
冷酷严冬期间，冰霜之镰额外造成20%的伤害。

 邪恶
天灾打击和脓疮打击的伤害提高10%。

 鲜血
当你在枯萎凋零中时，心脏打击可击中最多3名额外的敌人。

离开枯萎凋零后，其增益效果可持续4秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost
Frostscythe deals 20% increased damage during Remorseless Winter.

 Blood
Heart Strike hits up to 3 additional enemies while you remain in Death and Decay.

When leaving your Death and Decay you retain its bonus effects for 4 sec.

 Unholy
Scourge Strike and Festering Strike deal 10% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 制造死亡契约，为你恢复50%的最大生命值，但会吸收治疗效果，数值相当于最大生命值的30%，持续15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的符文熔铸的效果提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 吸血提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Leech by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高3%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 3% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冻结自己的血液，对昏迷效果免疫，受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用心灵冰冻成功打断敌人会产生10点符文能量，并使其冷却时间缩短3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 以极寒的能量攻击目标的心智，打断目标施法，并且使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗符文能量的技能会使你的近战攻击速度提高6%，持续10秒，最多叠加3次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。受到失控效果影响时，该加成额外提高6%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 死神脚步，枯萎凋零和死亡之握额外获得1次充能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜,  邪恶
受到的魔法伤害降低5%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。

 鲜血
受到的魔法伤害降低8%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost,  Unholy
Magic damage taken is reduced by 5% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.

 Blood
Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
汲取暗影界的力量，解除所有定身效果并使你的移动速度提高70%，持续4秒。任何行动都会取消此效果。

在此期间，任何效果都不会使你的移动速度减速至正常的170%以下。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 死亡契约的冷却时间缩短30秒，在其治疗吸收效果持续期间，你获得的治疗效果提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
死亡之握的射程提高10码。

在你杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人后，立即重置死亡之握的冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Increases the range of Death Grip by 10 yds.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Death Grip.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 被白霜强化时，凛风冲击对主目标的伤害提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When empowered by Rime, Howling Blast deals 30% increased damage to your primary target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜之柱期间，冰霜打击 [冰川突进: 、冰川突进]和凛风冲击必定触发杀戮机器，并有20%几率产生一个符文。

此外，冰霜之柱期间，符文武器增效使你的下一个湮灭或冰霜之镰不消耗符文。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
During Pillar of Frost, Frost Strike [Glacial Advance: Glacial Advance] and Howling Blast always grant Killing Machine and have a 20% chance to generate a Rune.

Additionally during Pillar of Frost, Empower Rune Weapon causes your next Obliterate or Frostscythe to cost no Runes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤辛达苟萨协助作战，持续8秒，对你前方锥形范围内的敌人每1秒造成[([111.83% of Attack Power]) * [(攻击强度 * 0.98)][((攻击强度 + [Offhand Attack Power]) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 攻击强度]点冰霜伤害。消耗杀戮机器或白霜效果会使持续时间延长0.8秒。对次要目标造成的伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing [(111.83% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 汲取敌人的意志来强化你的符文武器，对目标造成([260% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害，对附近敌人造成较少伤害，获得40点符文能量，并获得杀戮机器效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Drain the will of your enemy to empower your rune weapon, dealing (260% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage and reduced damage to enemies nearby, gaining 40 Runic Power, and grants you Killing Machine.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
湮灭造成的伤害提高10%，并有几率将目标及附近一名敌人的灵魂与你的灵魂捆在一起。

冰霜打击会斩断束缚，对这两个敌人造成([205.92% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.

Frost Strike severs the tethers, dealing (205.92% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage to both foes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
受白霜强化的凛风冲击会对次要目标额外造成50%伤害。

冷酷严冬对命中的敌人造成的伤害提高6%，最多叠加10层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 50% increased damage to secondary targets.

Remorseless Winter deals 6% increased damage to enemies it hits, stacking up to 10 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你的自动攻击伤害提高10%。

每层冰冷之爪都会提高伤害，并且可以额外叠加2次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Your auto attack damage is increased by 10%. 

This amount is increased for each stack of Icy Talons you have and it can stack up to 2 additional times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤一头冰霜巨龙，向前方40码内所有敌人发动吐息，造成([296.6% of Attack Power])点冰霜伤害，使敌人昏迷3秒，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a frostwyrm who breathes on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing (296.6% of Attack Power) Frost damage, stunning enemies for 3 sec, and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的消耗符文能量的技能有几率在4秒内额外造成30%的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Runic Power spending abilities have a chance to additionally deal 30% of the damage dealt over 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
凛风冲击现在额外以最大效能击中一个目标。

白霜使凛风冲击的伤害额外提高75%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Howling Blast now hits an additional target with maximum effectiveness. 

Rime increases Howling Blast damage done by an additional 75%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冷酷严冬期间每消耗一个符文，就会使冷酷严冬造成的伤害提高10%，并使其持续时间延长0.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each Rune spent during Remorseless Winter increases its damage by 10%, and extends its duration by 0.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冷酷严冬的伤害提高35%。冷酷严冬首次对3名不同的敌人造成伤害后，你获得白霜效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Remorseless Winter damage is increased by 35%. The first time Remorseless Winter deals damage to 3 different enemies, you gain Rime.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
一次横扫攻击，打击你前方所有的敌人，造成([48% of Attack Power])点冰霜伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

消耗杀戮机器使爆击造成4倍的普通伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
A sweeping attack that strikes all enemies in front of you for (48% of Attack Power) Frost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. 

Consumes Killing Machine to have its critical strikes deal 4 times the normal damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 以刺骨的寒风冲击目标，对目标造成[([50.6819% of Attack Power]) * [(攻击强度 * 0.98)][((攻击强度 + [Offhand Attack Power]) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 攻击强度] [诺森德之风: 点冰霜伤害，并对其施加冰霜疫病。 / 点冰霜伤害，对10码内的所有其他敌人造成较低的伤害，并使所有目标感染冰霜疫病。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blast the target with a frigid wind, dealing [(50.6819% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] [Northrend Winds: Frost damage and applying Frost Fever to the target / Frost damage to that foe, and reduced damage to all other enemies within 10 yards, infecting all targets with Frost Fever.]

subSpellsCn.name: 冰霜疫病
subSpellsCn.description: 疾病效果，在24秒内造成[([342.4% of Attack Power]) * [(攻击强度 * 0.98)][((攻击强度 + [Offhand Attack Power]) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 攻击强度]点冰霜伤害，每次造成伤害时有几率使死亡骑士获得4点符文能量。

subSpellsEn.name: Frost Fever
subSpellsEn.description: A disease that deals [(342.4% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用[寒冰之力附魔你的武器并快速打击敌人，造成[([198.089% of Attack Power])]点冰霜伤害。][寒冰之力附魔你的武器，并用两把武器快速打击敌人，造成总计[([139.308% of Attack Power]) + ([139.308% of Attack Power])]点冰霜伤害。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Chill your [weapon with icy power and quickly strike the enemy, dealing [(198.089% of Attack Power)] Frost damage.][weapons with icy power and quickly strike the enemy with both, dealing a total of [(139.308% of Attack Power) + (139.308% of Attack Power)] Frost damage.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 一次凶蛮打击，[造成[([105.731% of Attack Power])]点物理伤害和[([105.731% of Attack Power])]点冰霜伤害。][使用双武器发动攻击，造成总计[(([71.4221% of Attack Power]) + ([71.4221% of Attack Power]))]点物理伤害和[(([71.4221% of Attack Power]) + ([71.4221% of Attack Power]))]点冰霜伤害。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: A brutal attack [that deals [(105.731% of Attack Power)] Physical and [(105.731% of Attack Power)] Frost damage.][with both weapons that deals a total of [((71.4221% of Attack Power) + (71.4221% of Attack Power))] Physical and [((71.4221% of Attack Power) + (71.4221% of Attack Power))] Frost damage.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自动攻击爆击时有一定几率使你的下一个湮灭造成冰霜伤害且必定暴击，或使下一次冰霜之镰必定暴击且造成4倍的普通伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to make your next Obliterate deal Frost damage and critically strike, or make your next Frostscythe critically strike for 4 times the normal damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗杀戮机器效果时向目标施放一次冰川突进，产生60%的效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consuming Killing Machine fires a Glacial Advance through your target at 60% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗杀戮机器的效果时有20%的几率使你获得1枚符文。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consuming the Killing Machine effect has a 20% chance to grant you 1 Rune.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗杀戮机器效果会提供1%的爆击几率，持续10秒，最多叠加5层。叠加至5层时，你的下一个杀戮机器会消耗所有层数，使你的冰霜伤害提高10%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consuming Killing Machine grants 1% critical strike chance for 10 sec, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks your next Killing Machine consumes the stacks and grants you 10% increased Frost damage for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
湮灭和冰霜之镰会消耗所有杀戮机器，每层使造成的爆击伤害提高25%，并且使你的急速提高1.5%，持续8秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.

Multiple applications may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
鲜血
如果灵魂迸裂没有击中任何敌人，你获得10%力量，持续8秒。

灵魂浪潮对你死神印记主要目标的效果提高100%。

 冰霜
如果灵魂迸裂没有击中任何敌人，你获得8%力量，持续8秒。

灵魂浪潮对你死神印记主要目标的效果提高100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blood
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.

 Frost
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 8% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
死神印记的初始攻击会使你获得[3层白骨之盾][杀戮机器]。

死神印记的爆炸造成的伤害最多提高30%，由目标损失的生命值决定。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Reaper's Mark initial strike grants [3 charges of Bone Shield][Killing Machine].

Reaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
鲜血
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成([211.92% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害。

灵魂浪潮的爆击使敌人受到的暗影冰霜伤害提高5%，持续15秒，最多叠加2次。灵魂浪潮返程时必定爆击。

 冰霜
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成([96.7079% of Attack Power])点暗影冰霜伤害。

灵魂浪潮的爆击使敌人受到的暗影冰霜伤害提高5%，持续15秒，最多叠加2次。灵魂浪潮返程时必定爆击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blood
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing (211.92% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.

 Frost
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing (96.7079% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜
白霜强化的凛风冲击对主要目标的伤害提高60%，现在造成暗影冰霜伤害。

暗影冰霜伤害会施加2层死神印记，爆击时施加4层。

 鲜血
血液沸腾造成的伤害提高30%，现在造成暗影冰霜伤害。

暗影冰霜伤害会施加2层死神印记，爆击时施加4层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blood
Blood Boil deals 30% increased damage, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.

 Frost
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.
